sub.text: In 2035, nobody can lie to you.
sub.speaker: vo

sub.text: Your glasses read the tiny expressions that last less than half a second.
sub.speaker: vo

sub.text: What someone says, and what their face means, side by side.
sub.speaker: vo

sub.text: When everyone can see the truth, lying stops being worth it.
sub.speaker: vo

sub.text: Not by force. Slowly. By habit.
sub.speaker: vo

sub.text: But the first face it learns to read is yours.
sub.speaker: vo
